To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a phage-displayed antibody library can be constructed using germlines rearranged immunoglobulins as source of antibody diversity and that frame-shifting PCR is useful to diversify the complementarity-determined region 3.
the antibody library constructed from germline rearrangement of immunoglobulin genes is as efficient as that of the conventional library constructed from immune cell mRNA.

a single-chain variable fragment antibody library can be constructed by using germline immunoglobulin variable region genes as source of repertoire, and frame-shifting PCR step was introduced to enhance diversity of CDRs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of single-chain variable fragment (scFv) libraries using splenocytic genomic DNA as source of antibody diversity.

the construction of a single-chain variable fragment (scFv) library derived from germline rearrangement of immunoglobulin genes, and the application of the library to the selection of scFv clones with high affinity and specificity towards the nucleocapsid of SARS-associated coronaviruses (SCoV).
the construction and characterization of single-chain variable fragment antibody library derived from germline rearrangements of immunoglobulin variable region genes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
germline rearrangement is an effective method for constructing antibody library.
the antibody repertoire of a naïve individual can be effectively represented using the germline rearrangement immunoglobulin variable region genes as source of the repertoire.
the germline library can be used for the construction of antibody library, but the immunized library may be preferred as it can provide a more diverse antibody repertoire.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
germline library is an alternative and valuable tool to study immune status and to develop antibodies for various purposes.
the antibody repertoires of immunized and naïve individuals can be effectively represented by the germline scfv library.
germline rearrangement of Ig genes could be a source of antibody repertoire and the fsPCR could be a novel tool to diversify CDR3.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of germline Ig gene rearrangement in constructing antibody library can be an alternative to the conventional method of using mRNA of immune cells.
the germline rearrangement scFv library can be a valuable tool for the study of antibody repertoire and the generation of antibodies against specific antigens.
the use of germline rearrangement Ig variable genes as source for antibody repertoire is a feasible approach to construct highly diversified antibody library.
